pr_body:
Currently we wrap JsonEOFException from advancing the json parser into our own XContentEOFException, but this has the drawback that is results in 500 errors on the client side. Instead this should be 400 errors. We should throw XContentParseException instead like we e.g. already to in the "nextFieldName" method or elsewhere in JsonXContentParser.

Closes #111542
pr_title: Json parsing exceptions should not cause 500 errors
pr_comment: tagging @elastic/es-core-infra for awareness and since you own general xcontent issues, but we found this while looking into 500s from the "_search" endpoint, so also tagging search foundations.
Hi @cbuescher, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

review_comment: I do not think we should stop catching JsonEOFException. Rather, I think we should adjust the wrapper exception to exhibit the desired behavior when interacting with xcontent. One way to do so could be to change XContentEOFException to extend XContentParseException (which extends from IllegalArgumentException, and that translates to a 400).
